patch.value: GH-1519: preflight test run options before persisting linked-test edits

https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1519 reports on published 2026.10.20/plain non-Git trackers that test --add persists a link before refusing invalid --timeout, --pm-context, --env-set or --only-index values, so retries accumulate duplicate registrations. It also reports run counters on add-only --progress and generic errors for some invalid values. This is reporter evidence; current-head reproduction and implementation remain pending. The scope is admission of the entire requested link/run option combination before any write, beyond the earlier linked-context validation.

Exercise invalid timeout, context, environment and index options through CLI and native SDK with add/remove edits: preflight refusals must leave item bytes, links and history unchanged and name the offending flag/value with an honest no-change receipt. Define run-only options on registration-only calls consistently, including progress output without fabricated execution counters. Preserve valid add-plus-run behavior, audit real executed failures truthfully, and keep existing context-intake/refusal semantics intact; do not equate a real post-admission child failure with a preflight refusal.
Agents can safely retry invalid test-link requests without hidden edits or duplicates, while accepted registrations and genuine executions retain truthful mutation/run receipts.
